legend: The King of the Higherlands has organized a big dinner where he invited the whole royal family. The event will take place in a big square hall of n×n$$$n \times n$$$ meters, divided into n×n$$$n \times n$$$ squares. The king wants to invite as many guests as possible, but for each guest there needs to be space for a table. The tables in question are rectangular with dimensions of 1$$$1$$$ meter by 2$$$2$$$ meter. According to royal rules, any table should cover any two squares of the hall completely. To have enough room for the guests to sit, tables should not be adjacent. Of course, tables cannot be stacked on top of eachother.
Two grid squares are adjacent if they share an edge or a corner. Two tables are adjacent if any of their squares are adjacent.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤50$$$1 \le t \le 50$$$). The description of the test cases follows.
Each test case consists of one line. This line contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (n≤100$$$n \leq 100$$$) — the size of the hall.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n2$$$n^2$$$ over all testcases does not exceed 200000$$$200\,000$$$
output: For each testcase, print any n×n$$$n \times n$$$ grid with the maximum number of tables, that are not stacked on top of each other and are not adjacent. In the grid, print a '\#'$$$\texttt{'\#'}$$$ if the square is covered by a table, and print a '.'$$$\texttt{'.'}$$$ if the square is not covered.
Print the n×n$$$n \times n$$$ grid on n$$$n$$$ lines of n$$$n$$$ characters each. If there are multiple solutions, print any.
note: In the first sample, the hall is only 1×1$$$1 \times 1$$$ meter, so not even a single table fits.
In the second sample, 1$$$1$$$ table can be placed in the hall. It can be proven that 2$$$2$$$ tables or more is impossible.
In the third sample, a hall with 2$$$2$$$ tables is shown, and that is also optimal.

legend.ai: 高地之王举办了一场盛大的晚宴，邀请了整个王室家族。晚宴将在一间边长为 n 米、面积为 n×n$$$n \times n$$$ 平方米的大方厅中举行，方厅被划分为 n×n$$$n \times n$$$ 个正方形格子。国王希望邀请尽可能多的宾客，但每位宾客都需要有一张桌子。桌子的形状为矩形，尺寸为 1$$$1$$$ 米 × 2$$$2$$$ 米。按照王室规定，每张桌子必须完整覆盖方厅中的两个格子。为了让宾客有足够的空间就座，桌子之间不能相邻。当然，桌子也不能彼此叠放。
如果两个格子共边或共角，则它们相邻。如果两张桌子所覆盖的任意两个格子相邻，则这两张桌子相邻。

input.ai: 每个输入包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤50$$$1 \le t \le 50$$$)。接下来是各测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例占一行。该行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(n≤100$$$n \leq 100$$$)，表示方厅的大小。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出任意一个 n×n$$$n \times n$$$ 网格，其中桌子的数量最多，且桌子之间既不叠放也不相邻。对于被桌子覆盖的格子，输出 '\#'$$$\texttt{'\#'}$$$；对于未被覆盖的格子，输出 '.'$$$\texttt{'.'}$$$。
在 n×n$$$n \times n$$$ 的网格中输出 n$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个字符。若有多种解，输出任意一种即可。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，大厅只有 1×1$$$1 \times 1$$$ 米，因此连一张桌子都放不下。
在第二个样例中，大厅里可以放置 1$$$1$$$ 张桌子。可以证明，放置 2$$$2$$$ 张或更多桌子是不可能的。
第三个样例展示了一个放置了 2$$$2$$$ 张桌子的大厅，而这也是最优方案。
